```python
def slugify(text):
    """Convert text to a URL-safe slug: lowercase, replace spaces with dashes, remove punctuation."""
    import string
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace spaces with dashes
    text = text.replace(" ", "-")
    # Remove punctuation
    translator = str.maketrans(string.punctuation, " *'\"<>{}[]|\\^`~!@#$%^&*()_+-=;:,./?")
    text = text.translate(translator)
    return text
```
